name: raylit
description: Raylit: a simple V2Ray / Xray client for the desktop (Electron + React + Node engine)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix engine install && npm --prefix ui install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.build: npm --prefix engine run build && npm --prefix ui run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/run.mjs desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix engine run typecheck && npm --prefix ui run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
